original_question: Wata gonar kankana ta samar da kananan kankana 120. Ashlyn ta je gonar bayan wata biyu, ta gano cewa kashi 30% na kankanar sun isa girbi, don haka ta kai su gida. Bayan sati biyu ta dawo, 3/4 na sauran kankanar sun isa suma, sai ta girbe. kankana nawa ne ba a shirya girbinsu ba bayan makonni biyu?
